question: On which of the following component of chloroplast is chlorophyll arranged?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thylakoids**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Chlorophyll is primarily arranged in the **thylakoids** of the chloroplast.
 
• Thylakoids are membrane-bound compartments inside chloroplasts and cyanobacteria.
 
• They are the site of the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis.
